preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and the restriction k satisfy 1 ≤ k < n ≤ 10^6.
The list p contains exactly n-1 integers representing the parents of vertices 2 through n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n-1))
preconditions.description: Each parent in p is an integer between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The maximum number of different leaves visited is at least 1.
The maximum number of different leaves visited does not exceed the total number of vertices.
